title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Leadville grid point, 15-24 August 2016-2025
claims: The requested grid point at 39.2536 N, 106.2978 W returns an elevation of 3,080 m.
For 15-24 August 2016-2025 (100 day-samples), daily high temperatures ranged from 54.9 to 75.7 degrees F with a median of 67.1 degrees F.
Daily low temperatures ranged from 34.2 to 45.5 degrees F with a median of 40.0 degrees F.
33 of 100 days recorded at least 1 mm of precipitation; 9 of 100 recorded at least 5 mm; the single-day maximum was 20.1 mm.
These are modelled grid-point values, not measurements taken on the race course.

verification.checkedVia: PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod 读取 Open-Meteo archive API JSON，重算 min/median/max 与降水计数
verification.note: 2026-11-25 复核：取 2016–2025 每年 8 月 15–24 日共 100 天；网格点海拔 3,080 m，低于 Hope Pass 3,818 m，不能代表山口温度。

daily.temperature_2m_min 100 项：重算 min 34.2 / median 40.0 / max 45.5 °F。
daily.precipitation_sum 100 项：≥1mm 33 天，≥5mm 9 天，最大 20.1 mm。
